gameDescriptionHtml:
Klobgniak is a first-person puzzle game where the player is trapped in a fictional space and time. The player will have to solve puzzles in order to escape from the “Klobgniak’s Home” where the “Others” now (un)happily reside.

Game Features

  • A? – Your main goal is to escape from the so-called, surreal and confusing, “Klobgniak’s Home” and if possible, solve Klobgniak’s mystery and find his hideout.
  • MAKING NOISE – Try not to make noise and be well hidden. Walking, running, jumping and other interactions with the environment can be heard, so wait for the right moment to act. In several rooms there are small “homes” where you can hide. While you’re hidden here you cannot be spotted or “Returned“.
  • RETURNED – Every time you’re Returned, you’ll have to start over and all the progress you’ve made will be lost. When that happens, some items that will be important for you to make progress could be hidden in different, random locations and places, and sometimes, some kind of tool will be needed to get to them. If you are caught with some Klobgniak’s items, you will be punished.
  • PUNISHMENT – “Rebels and thieves must be punished.” While you are punished, your movement is restricted. You are required to pay to remove the punishment. However, you could escape without paying.
